1.consolidated_definition: Arbusto de ramas largas y flexibles, flores pequeñas de color blanco y fruta oblonga de color rojo; su madera tiene numerosas aplicaciones. (Erythroxylaceae; Erythroxylum brevipes, E. obovatum, E. obtusum).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Shrub with long and flexible branches, small white flowers, and oval red fruit; its wood has numerous applications. (Family Erythroxylaceae; species include Erythroxylum brevipes, E. obovatum, E. obtusum).
